column1: # Aliases whose GlyphWiki drawings differ only in how a stroke joins another or where a
# component sits; every stroke and every contact is the same. Read by scripts/ivd.py derive.
# GlyphWiki differences are measured in its 200-unit em.

column3: The left-falling stroke of 吳 starts with its own head on the horizontal above it in one drawing and grows from it in the other.
The left-falling stroke of 勹 in 曷 starts with its own head under 日 in one drawing and grows from 日 in the other.
羽 sits about 3.5 units further right and 0.7 units wider, and the left-falling stroke of 兀 starts with its own head in one drawing and grows from the horizontal above in the other.
